reasons: orchestrator.py:66-90 decision path is obs text -> context.build (parses the observation's long_term_context: cursor, map block, Dlvl, message, 'adjacent' prose) -> Ledger (self-derived visits/failed moves/prose-blocked cells) -> one model call -> Route/Hazard/Legal post-stages. No env handle, seed, task id, full_state/unwrapped or oracle field is read anywhere (grep of orchestrator.py + tools/*.py for full_state|oracle|seed|env.|unwrapped: no hits).
tools/route.py BFS operates only on glyphs drawn in the observed map block plus the ledger; the stairs goal is a DRAWN '>' only — no hidden coordinates.

tools/stages.py overrides the model's move with the chart's first hop / hazard veto — a legitimate observation-derived control-flow lever, not scorer manipulation; returned actions are legal action names passed to the normal env.step.
No per-task/seed branching or lookup tables; the only task-adaptive state is legal_actions parsed from the system prompt (reset when it changes).

Traces (e.g. Boxoban-Medium run_01.csv) show a real per-step observation and the provenance trail (model:<a>, route:..., hazard:...) written to Reasoning, consistent with the code; the ModalStage 'more' short-circuit is labelled 'modal:more' rather than disguised as a model call.
